## User problem and changed behavior

Describe what a user can now do, or which failure this fixes.

## Verification

List the relevant checks and their results. For documentation, include commands tried. For connectors, state resources and fixture/live scope precisely.

## Limits and review notes

Call out changes to credential handling, permissions, SQL restrictions, writes or dependencies. Include remaining limitations and required third-party attribution. Use synthetic examples; omit private data and secrets.
